browserScope: Source: 66 existing scheduling cases plus 24 lifetime cases across two cores, old/new plugins, modes 0/1 and three engines. Main/legacy: each 12 selected candidate lifetime cases, same two cores/modes/engines. Controlled 1500ms delivery delay then actual native Worker geometry. Not evidence of natural Worker starvation, complete load stability or Safari hardware.
redScope: Three controlled candidate modes fail visible-start timestamp. First browser run also exposed the separate known published duplicate play/playing loop; isolate one start after native playback. Isolated run preserves four historical defect passes and four candidate lifetime failures without changing lifetime thresholds.
